cards.name: Taskboard Lab
cards.task: Introduce a fictional task board through backlog, active work and completed work. Show the interface rather than claiming time savings.
cards.headline: Make the next step visible
cards.direction: A single task moves through three columns; labels stay readable after each movement.
cards.patch: Change the closing CTA to See the workflow; leave the task movement and sound unchanged.

cards.name: Fieldnote Lab
cards.task: Introduce a fictional research notebook using a note, a linked source and a tagged collection. Do not claim AI features or real customers.
cards.headline: Keep the source in sight
cards.direction: Editorial paper layers connect a note to a source, then settle into an ordered collection.
cards.patch: Increase the reading hold on the source reference within the fixed duration; update affected audio markers.

cards.name: Release Lab
cards.task: Introduce a fictional release checklist with draft, review and release states. Do not invent integrations or deployment speed.
cards.headline: One release. A clear checklist.
cards.direction: A compact checklist assembles into a release panel with a restrained final status change.
cards.patch: Replace the second checklist label with Review assets; keep all other labels and timing unchanged.

cards.name: Light Study Lab
cards.task: Introduce a fictional photography workbook covering direction, contrast and reflection. Show lesson exercises, not student outcomes.
cards.headline: Learn to notice the light
cards.direction: Three light studies show the same geometric object under changing illumination.
cards.patch: Change the closing workbook cover color to the secondary brand color without changing the lesson order or music.

cards.name: Type Study Lab
cards.task: Introduce a fictional typography mini-course covering hierarchy, spacing and rhythm. Avoid certification, enrollment or income claims.
cards.headline: Give every line a purpose
cards.direction: The words themselves demonstrate hierarchy, spacing and rhythm with generous reading holds.
cards.patch: Replace the headline with Make the message readable and verify actual text bounds.

cards.name: Week Study Lab
cards.task: Introduce a fictional printable planning kit containing a weekly grid, a priority card and a reflection sheet. Avoid productivity promises.
cards.headline: A little room to plan
cards.direction: A quiet desktop composition reveals the three printable pages with a soft rhythmic bed.
cards.patch: Move the priority card to the opening beat; preserve the fixed duration and synchronize the sound change.
